The '''capital city''' of [[Haxim's province]] on [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] was the location of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[bacteriological research outpost]]. After a [[flesh-eating bacterium]] was accidentally released, the city was destroyed by the Empire in an attempt to contain the spread of the bacterium.
